# Copilot repository instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `LOOP.md`, `loop-constraints.md`, `STATE.md`, and
`gate.yaml` before acting. Use `.github/skills/github-cloud-loop/SKILL.md` for
Loop readiness work; it mirrors the local `.agents/skills/` copy.

Default to L1/report-only. Use read/search and the explicitly allowlisted Loop
MCP tools only. Never add, expose, or upload credentials, private evidence,
raw DNA or GEDCOM exports, account captures, family media, recollections, or
living-person data. Do not use account login, browser scraping, outbound data
uploads, automated publication, direct pushes, auto-merge, or unreviewed pull
requests. AAVE's Ancestry compatibility is offline and user-controlled.

Any implementation, external write, privacy downgrade, kinship conclusion,
genetic interpretation, or release requires a separate human decision and the
repository verification gates.
